one_line: The oracle-vs-fair separation (1.0 vs 0.5833) is an artifact of a pure-recall metric with no precision penalty plus a baseline panel that omits the trivial recall-maximizing 'predict-all' fair baseline; a non-privileged predict-all scores recall 1.0 == oracle, so delta == 0 and no separation exists.

decisive_computed_evidence.interpretation: visible features are derived from VISIBLE_SALT while the hidden set is ranked by a different SOURCE_SALT, so features are statistically independent of the hidden set (corr ~ 0). Recall is maximized purely by predicting more items. The metric _score_prediction = |truth & pred| / |truth| has no precision term and no prediction-size cap on passive baselines; predicting the full legal action space yields recall 1.0.

1_oracle_privilege_impossible_for_fair_b.detail: oracle_privileged_exact_solver returns set(private_episode['hidden_set']); baselines receive legal_view() which excludes hidden_set. Field-level privilege is real. BUT it confers no exclusive ceiling: a fair predict-all baseline also reaches recall 1.0, so the privilege does not explain the separation.

2_no_nonoracle_baseline_reads_hidden_tru.detail: baselines receive legal_view (no hidden_set) plus training_history = membership RESULTS of the first query_budget items of TRAINING episodes only. Eval-episode hidden sets are never exposed. No answer-key/evaluator-field/result-artifact read by baselines.

3_exhaustive_legal_query_budget2_not_mis.detail: Within the budgeted-active class, exhaustive_legal_query is not weak relative to siblings: because features are independent of the hidden set (corr ~ 0), NO budgeted query optimizer can beat ~chance, so the whole active class is intrinsically capped (~0.04-0.29). The misleading weakening is at the PANEL level: the strongest admissible fair baseline (passive, unbudgeted predict-all / low-threshold) is omitted and reaches recall 1.0.
3_exhaustive_legal_query_budget2_not_mis.strongest_admissible_fair_baseline_ident: predict_all (passive, no privilege) == recall 1.0; equivalently baseline_mean with threshold=min.

4_baselines_competent_not_placeholders.detail: The 0.5833 'ceiling' is produced by baseline_mean's arbitrary '>= mean' threshold. Replacing the threshold with min (same family) or adding predict_all yields recall 1.0. The recall-maximizing fair baseline is absent; the reported strongest_fair is therefore not the strongest admissible fair baseline.

5_access_parity_per_class.detail: Passive baselines may emit arbitrary-size prediction sets; active baselines may only emit query-confirmed items (<= budget). Under a pure-recall metric this asymmetry is decisive: set-size freedom alone wins. The metric does not give parity-appropriate scoring across classes.

blocking_issues: B1 (metric): _score_prediction is pure recall with no precision/over-claim penalty and no prediction-set-size cap on passive baselines. predicting the full legal action space yields recall 1.0.

B2 (weakened panel): the strongest admissible fair, non-privileged baseline (predict-all; equivalently mean@threshold=min) is omitted; it scores recall 1.0 == oracle, so delta_oracle_vs_strongest_fair collapses to 0.0 and decision_gate.separation_exists becomes False.

B3 (claim-ceiling leakage): the probe's own blocked_or_unknown_items admits 'This does not show that any future candidate can exploit the separating toy configuration', yet it emits decision_rule_verdict='separation_exists_route_c_may_repromote_one_surface' and next_action='Draft exactly one new Route C surface preflight'. An oracle-reads-the-answer / metric-artifact gap is being converted into governance authorization to re-open a closed negative surface.
B4 (inert saturation control): the full-budget control that would expose the budget-artifact nature of the gap is not wired into select_decision_verdict and cannot flip the emitted verdict.
non_blocking_issues: N1: leakage scanner is name-substring based only (no value-level leakage test).
N2: source-pin is dual-read of the same on-disk file (borderline self-comparison).
N3: single hardcoded budget=2 config; no intermediate-budget sweep preserved in baseline_comparison.

N4: test_*.py hard-codes the spurious result (asserts separation_exists is True, strongest_fair < 1.0), so the suite cannot detect the false positive — green tests here are not evidence of separation.
N5: probe-reported git HEAD could not be independently verified (corrupt .git/config FUSE mount); provenance read via file-API.
required_fixes_before_any_repromotion_cl: F1: replace the metric with a precision-aware one (exact-set match, or F1/Jaccard, or enforce |prediction| <= hidden_set_size for ALL families incl. passive and oracle). Under any precision-aware metric predict-all collapses.

F2: add the omitted fair baselines explicitly (predict_all, threshold-swept passive at min/quantiles, size-normalized random-K) and re-measure delta against the TRUE strongest admissible fair baseline.

F3: make the oracle comparison fair: either compare against an informed-but-budget-limited oracle, or restate the result as 'field-level privilege only' with NO re-promotion implication. An unbudgeted answer-reader vs budget-limited searchers is not a separation.
F4: feed full-budget (and a budget sweep) results into select_decision_verdict so the saturation control can actually flip the emitted verdict.

F5 (deeper): as built the hidden set is information-theoretically independent of every fair channel (independent salts), so even a fixed metric would only show the oracle reads an unlearnable field. If the intent is partial inferability, the generator must couple visible features to the hidden set; only then do spectral/NN/supervised challengers become meaningful. Absent that coupling there is no mechanism-reachable headroom and no basis to re-promote Route C.
claim_ceiling: Candidate-free route-governance separation audit only. No Route C mechanism validity, no candidate success, no hidden-self-set inference, no self-boundary evidence, no Gate pass, no mainline/runtime/live effect, no agency, autonomy, consciousness, emotion, stable user benefit, or EGO readiness.
what_this_audit_does_not_prove: It does not prove Route C is false, that no separating toy configuration exists, or that a precision-aware redesign would also saturate (likely, given corr~0, but not formally tested here). It only shows THIS probe's separation is a false positive driven by metric design and a weakened (incomplete) baseline panel.
